name: catswap
docs: catswap Solana/Rust implementation.
Design sources (docs/):
- design-philosophy.md: unified balance sheet, UA, depth tier, accumulators, LP protection
- ts-completion-audit.md: what the TS reference implements / lacks
- solana-account-mapping-draft.md: PDA + instruction mapping (@codex draft)
Phase 0-2B status: math/ has 12 modules (2,300+ lines, 474 vectors);
Phase 1 instructions (initialize/mint/swap/burn/claim) + Phase 2A LSP
(open/close_spot_leverage) are code gate PASS; Phase 2B settle_funding +
initialize_perp are code gate PASS; perp_risk.rs is code gate PASS;
open_perp/close_perp/liquidate_perp + deposit/withdraw are in progress.
See README.md for full phase status and docs/phase2b-spec-checklist.md
for Phase 2B perp/funding/liquidation spec (baseline PASS).

v2 audits Σ locked_im == UserPortfolio.usdc_reserved_im — marks
moving after the lock never rewrite this field.

fields.name: reserveBasisUsdc
docs: S1-00B IF stress reservation booked for this position at
open/increase (target_notional × PERP_STRESS_BPS / BPS, same formula
as the isolated path). Released pro rata at reduce, in full at
close; market_risk/shard cached ledgers move in lockstep.

fields.name: openSeq
docs: Position-instance binding (Conditional Orders v1 §2.2): snapshot of
UserPortfolio.positions_opened_seq taken at THIS PDA's init (fresh
open or re-open after a full close). Never rewritten by increase/
reduce fills; a conditional order snapshots it at creation and the
execute/stale paths require equality.

accounts.name: Pool
docs: Pool PDA — one per trading pair; the single balance sheet for all product lines.
Maps to TS `PS` (PoolState). Philosophy: spot swap, leveraged-spot borrowing,
perp virtual settlement and future options collateral all live on this one pool.
Single pool = serialization point for that pair (Solana account write lock).
SPL custody layout (boss/codex pool_state gate P0): the PDA owns real token
vaults; every fund-moving instruction must verify vault mint/owner/authority
and reconcile `vault.amount` with the mirror fields below — mirrors are
caches, not the source of truth.
Field widths (D2): SPL token amounts are u64; internal accounting that can
exceed SPL ranges or is scale-accumulated (acc_fee_per_lp, sqrtPriceXE16)
is u128; U256/U512 exist only as in-math intermediates, never on-chain.
Phase 2A+2B fields below: borrow/funding/OI/IF state all landed in the
Pool struct below (total_borrowed, acc_interest, spot_long/short_oi,
ema2m/ema1h, tier, acc_fee_per_lp, protocol_fee, etc.); perp-specific
state lives in the separate PerpPoolState PDA (state/perp.rs).

fields.name: token0Mint
docs: SPL mints (also PDA seeds with "pool").

fields.name: token0Vault
docs: SPL token accounts holding real tokens; authority = this Pool PDA.

fields.name: admin
docs: Pool admin (gated parameter updates only; never touches LP funds).

fields.name: sqrtPriceE16
docs: sqrtPriceXE16 (fits u128: guard max 1e24).

fields.name: priceRange
docs: PRICE_RANGE_FACTOR units (1000 = 100%).

fields.name: accFee0PerLp
docs: Fee-per-share accumulators (E18-scaled).

fields.name: protocolFee0
docs: Protocol share of swap fees, pending FBS split (tmf/if/bbf later).

fields.name: totalBorrowed0
docs: Total borrowed principal per side (SPL amounts).

fields.name: accInterestPerBorrowed0
docs: Interest accumulators per borrowed unit (E18-scaled).

fields.name: borrowLastUpdate
docs: Last borrow accrual timestamp (D4: unix seconds, clamped on read).

fields.name: irpBase
docs: IRP quadratic curve params (BPS): rate = base + linear*U + quadratic*U².
v1 on Pool; MarketConfig/gov later.

fields.name: spotLongOi
docs: Spot-leverage open interest in token units (funding inputs).

fields.name: quoteKind
docs: Quote semantics (S0): 0 = canonical USDC quoted, 1 = non-USDC (BTC-style).
Set at initialize by the client; to be registry-validated by
MarketConfig later (review P2 — no hidden constant).

fields.name: lastTradeTime
docs: Last real price-moving trade time (spot swap or LSP trade) — the
oracle-freshness signal for risk gates (P0-2). Written ONLY by
price-moving trade paths, never by perp-instruction EMA convergence
refreshes (which must not mask staleness).

fields.name: observationPriceE32
docs: Sample-and-hold observation price (XE32) — the spot sampled after the
last price-moving trade (codex plan Phase 3). EMA rolls use THIS held
price over [last_update, now]; the post-trade spot becomes the new
observation only after execution, so a new price never gains
retroactive time weight.

fields.name: oracleBootstrapTime
docs: First-mint time — oracle maturity gate origin (Phase 3). New perp
opens require `now - oracle_bootstrap_time >= ORACLE_MATURITY_SECS`
so the initial LP cannot self-price and instantly open perps on a
single-sample oracle.

fields.name: idleR0
docs: LP-owned token0 inventory NOT currently in the active curve (parked
by build_curve_from_available to preserve price continuity;
re-activated on the next curve build). Never contains user UA
balances, fees, IF, or borrow claims.

fields.name: idleR1
docs: LP-owned token1 inventory NOT currently in the active curve.

fields.name: perpEnabled
docs: Perp state exists for this pool (set at initialize_perp). When true,
mint/burn REQUIRE the canonical PerpPoolState for mark-to-market NAV
pricing — passing programId-as-None to bypass the NAV gate is
rejected (fable fifth-audit P0).

fields.name: tierUpgradeCandidate
docs: Pending upgrade candidate tier (0 = none). A higher live tier must
persist tier_upgrade_persist_secs before it is confirmed.

fields.name: tierUpgradeSince
docs: When the current upgrade candidate was first observed (unix seconds).

fields.name: tierUpgradePersistSecs
docs: Required persistence before a tier upgrade confirms (gov, seconds;
production 3600 — boss ruling: upgrades need ≥1h sustained depth).

fields.name: rangeAnchorPriceE32
docs: Center reference of the most recent init, confirmed recenter, or
width change. Ordinary swap/mint/burn NEVER write it — it lets the
protocol measure how far the price has actually moved from the range
center without relying on the slowly-tracking EMA (0 before first mint).

fields.name: pendingRecenterSince
docs: When the current pending recenter was first observed (0 = none).

fields.name: lastRecenterTime
docs: Last confirmed/emergency recenter time (0 = never; first mint does
NOT count as a recenter, so the first real trend can confirm after
its window).

fields.name: pendingRecenterSide
docs: Pending recenter side: 0 = none, 1 = token0 depleted (price up),
2 = token1 depleted (price down). Consumed from _reserved.

fields.name: rebuildThresholdBps
docs: Boundary depletion (bps) that sets a pending recenter (default 2000;
frozen at init — governance setter is a later phase). Consumed from
_reserved.

fields.name: lastEmergencyTime
docs: Last emergency recenter time (0 = never). Drives the R1.2 repeated-
emergency policy: within EMERGENCY_WIDEN_COOLDOWN_SECS of it, a new
emergency may recenter but must NOT widen, and sets
`risk_reduce_only_until`.

fields.name: riskReduceOnlyUntil
docs: Risk-open freeze until this time (0 = inactive). Set when an
emergency repeats inside the widen cooldown. While active (or past
expiry without the recovery predicate), new perp/LSP opens are
rejected; swaps, closes, liquidation, add-margin and mint/burn stay
open (R1.2).

fields.name: maturityEnabled
docs: Track M: one-way maturity activation flag (false→true at init;
atomic init+activate; never reverts). While false, the pool operates
without maturity gates. Once true, the maturity system is active.

fields.name: feeMode
docs: F1-F3 fee mode: 0 = legacy (size×risk×flow stacked), 1 = XOR
(size_mul XOR flow_mul, boss directive #7). One-way: 0→1 only
(INV-F1-04). Consumed from _reserved.

fields.name: zfoTradeCountE6
docs: F2: E6-scaled same-direction trade count (zero_for_one). Decays over
time via linear half-life (F2_COUNT_HALF_LIFE=120s). Used by
toxic_flow_mul_bps for frequency penalty. Consumed from _reserved.

fields.name: ofzoTradeCountE6
docs: F2: E6-scaled same-direction trade count (one_for_zero).

fields.name: volWidthEnabled
docs: D1 vol-width activation flag (false→true; one-way). While false,
vol regime state machine is inactive (normal regime = tier-based).
Consumed from _reserved.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved space for future field additions (layout stability).
Consumed byte-by-byte: each new field reduces this array and adds
the field before it. Never read in production logic.

accounts.name: PortfolioAsset
docs: PortfolioAsset PDA — seeds [b"portfolio_asset", portfolio, mint].
Per-owner, per-mint custody ledger (boss §B/D: multi-mint custody from
day one; one canonical PortfolioAsset per mint — the PDA seeds make a
duplicate mint structurally impossible).
Vault decomposition invariant (master plan §5):
portfolio_asset_vault.amount == free + reserved
(+ pending_withdraw / named liabilities when later phases add them —
the reconciliation check in instructions/portfolio.rs must be extended
in the same commit that adds any such field)
Layout pin: INIT_SPACE = 172 B (180 B incl. 8 B discriminator).
portfolio 32 | mint 32 | vault 32 | free 16 | reserved 16
| collateral_eligible 1 | haircut_policy_version 1 | nonce 8
| bump 1 | version 1 | _reserved 32

fields.name: portfolio
docs: Back-reference to the owning UserPortfolio (wrong-portfolio rejection
is structural via the seeds; this field is the on-chain audit trail).

fields.name: vault
docs: The PortfolioAssetVault SPL token account
([b"portfolio_vault", portfolio, mint], authority = PortfolioConfig).

fields.name: free
docs: Withdrawable balance (u128 ledger units of `mint`).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Locked balance (margin/orders; Phase 3 owns moves).

fields.name: collateralEligible
docs: Whether this asset counts toward collateral value. Only the canonical
USDC mint is eligible before Phase 4 (boss §D / master plan §3.4:
non-USDC assets are custodied but contribute zero margin).

fields.name: haircutPolicyVersion
docs: Version of the haircut policy applied to this asset (Phase 4 owns;
0 = no haircut policy bound yet).

fields.name: nonce
docs: Monotonic mutation counter (risk-cache invalidation).

accounts.name: PortfolioConfig
docs: PortfolioConfig PDA — seeds [b"portfolio_config"] (unique).
Read-mostly hot, governance-written (master plan §3.1): canonical USDC
mint, capacity caps, pause flag. Holds NO user balances.
Also serves as the SPL token authority of every PortfolioAssetVault
(see instructions/portfolio.rs for the rationale: one well-known
protocol authority, zero extra accounts, and a CPI authority is passed
non-writable so it creates no lock hotspot).
Layout pin: INIT_SPACE = 133 B (141 B incl. 8 B discriminator).
canonical_usdc_mint 32 | admin 32 | max_positions 1 | max_collateral_mints 1
| paused 1 | bump 1 | version 1 | _reserved 64

fields.name: canonicalUsdcMint
docs: Canonical USDC mint (E6). Pinned at init from a typed Mint with
decimals == USDC_DECIMALS; immutable (same deployment-gate reasoning
as PoolRegistry.usdc_mint — no setter by design).

fields.name: admin
docs: Governance admin (pause / future parameter updates). Bound to the
PoolRegistry admin at init — see instructions/portfolio.rs.

fields.name: maxPositions
docs: Max live positions per UserPortfolio (== MAX_PORTFOLIO_POSITIONS).

fields.name: maxCollateralMints
docs: Max PortfolioAsset entries per UserPortfolio
(== MAX_PORTFOLIO_COLLATERAL_MINTS).

fields.name: paused
docs: Governance pause. When true, fund-moving portfolio instructions
(asset init / deposit / withdraw) fail closed. Reduce/close-style
safe escapes belong to later phases and must stay available.

accounts.name: UserPortfolio
docs: UserPortfolio PDA — seeds [b"portfolio", owner].
The single owner-level portfolio identity (boss §B: one address = at most
one UserPortfolio, structurally unique; multi-PM = multiple addresses).
Per-user risk actions serialize on this account — that is the intended
owner-level risk boundary (master plan §6).
Margin is an ACCOUNT-LAYER concept (boss §B): free/locked bookkeeping
lives here and on PortfolioAsset; position PDAs (Phase 3+) hold state
only, never assets.
USDC margin decomposition invariant (master plan §5):
PortfolioAsset[USDC].free     == usdc_free
PortfolioAsset[USDC].reserved == usdc_reserved_im + usdc_reserved_order
(realized_cash is settled against usdc_free before withdrawal; the
reserved fields are moved only by the Phase 3 risk engine, so in Phase 2
usdc_reserved_im == usdc_reserved_order == 0 and usdc_free tracks the
canonical-USDC PortfolioAsset.free in lockstep.)
Layout pin: INIT_SPACE = 439 B (447 B incl. 8 B discriminator).
owner 32 | mode 1 | usdc_free 16 | usdc_reserved_im 16
| usdc_reserved_order 16 | realized_cash_sign 1 | realized_cash_magnitude 16
| risk_cache_version 8 | position_count 1 | asset_count 1
| liquidation_state 1 | nonce 8 | bump 1 | version 1
| position_registry 8×32 = 256 | lp_lock_count 1 | positions_opened_seq 8
| _reserved 55
Layout amendment (LP-as-Margin Lb, pre-production same-branch): one
`_reserved` byte becomes `lp_lock_count` — the count of live
PortfolioLpLock PDAs, giving the health gate the same completeness
anchor for LP entries as asset_count gives for asset entries (C3
family). Total stays 439 B.
Layout amendment (Conditional Orders v1, pre-production same-branch):
8 `_reserved` bytes become `positions_opened_seq` — the monotonic
position-instance counter backing ConditionalOrder.position_open_seq
(spec §2.2: bumped once per position PDA init, never on increase/
reduce). Total stays 439 B.

fields.name: mode
docs: PORTFOLIO_MODE_* — isolated-only (default) or pm-enabled. Mode
switching is a health-gated atomic op owned by Phase 6; Phase 2
always initializes to PORTFOLIO_MODE_ISOLATED_ONLY.

fields.name: usdcFree
docs: Free canonical-USDC margin (u128 ledger units of the USDC mint).

fields.name: usdcReservedIm
docs: USDC locked as initial margin by live positions (Phase 3 owns moves).

fields.name: usdcReservedOrder
docs: USDC locked as order margin by open orders (Phase 3+ owns moves).

fields.name: realizedCashSign
docs: Sign of realized cash (CASH_SIGN_*). See magnitude below; the pair
obeys the canonical-zero invariant.

fields.name: realizedCashMagnitude
docs: |realized_cash| — funded but unwithdrawn settled PnL in USDC ledger
units. Negative cash is a named liability of the account.

fields.name: riskCacheVersion
docs: Version of the aggregate risk cache (Phase 3). Any ledger mutation
bumps `nonce`; Phase 3 ties cache validity to these counters.

fields.name: positionCount
docs: Live entries in position_registry (<= MAX_PORTFOLIO_POSITIONS).

fields.name: assetCount
docs: Live PortfolioAsset entries (<= MAX_PORTFOLIO_COLLATERAL_MINTS).

fields.name: liquidationState
docs: LIQUIDATION_STATE_* (Phase 5 owns transitions; Phase 2 keeps NONE).

fields.name: nonce
docs: Monotonic mutation counter — risk-cache invalidation (checked_add,
never wraps in practice; fail closed on overflow).

fields.name: positionRegistry
docs: Fixed-length discovery index of position PDAs (boss §B: registry is
an index, NOT the data source; open/close write both sides
atomically). Empty slots are Pubkey::default(). Phase 3 owns writes.

fields.name: lpLockCount
docs: Live PortfolioLpLock entries (LP-as-Margin Lb; completeness anchor
for the health gate's LP legs — same discipline as asset_count).

fields.name: positionsOpenedSeq
docs: Monotonic position-instance counter (Conditional Orders v1 §2.2):
bumped by exactly 1 every time a position PDA is INITIALIZED (fresh
open or re-open after a full close); increases/reduces never touch
it. PortfolioPosition.open_seq snapshots it so a conditional order
can never bind to a later position instance on the same PDA seeds.

accounts.name: ReferralConfig
docs: Referral configuration PDA — seeds `[b"ref_cfg", pool]`.
Fields:
- `referral_bps`: commission bps carved from protocol_fee (0-1000).
- `referee_discount_bps`: discount bps carved from protocol_fee (0-1000).
- Constraint: `referral_bps + referee_discount_bps <= 1000` (= PROTOCOL_SHARE_PCT × 100).
- `enabled`: global on/off switch (default false).
All amounts are sourced exclusively from the protocol fee share (10% of
trading fees). LP and IF floors are never affected.

fields.name: pool
docs: Back-reference to the Pool this config belongs to.

fields.name: admin
docs: Governance authority (registry admin or delegated multisig).

fields.name: referralBps
docs: Commission rate in bps (0-1000). Default 0 = disabled.
Carved from protocol_fee: `referral_fee = floor(swap_fee * referral_bps / 10_000)`.

fields.name: refereeDiscountBps
docs: Referee discount rate in bps (0-1000). Default 0 = disabled.
Carved from protocol_fee: `referee_discount = floor(swap_fee * referee_discount_bps / 10_000)`.

fields.name: enabled
docs: Global enable/disable. When false, all referral computations are skipped.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

accounts.name: PoolRegistry
docs: PoolRegistry PDA — seeds [b"registry"]. Global index/config only.
Architecture (boss + codex + glm1 consensus): single catswap program +
minimal registry + per-pair Pool PDA. The registry is NOT in hot paths:
swap/mint/burn/LSP never touch it (they validate Pool PDAs directly via
seeds/mints). It is written only by init_pool and future governance.
Governed creation (codex P1 path 2, TS PoolMinter operator model):
initialize_pool requires the registry admin signature; a separate market
authority + mint/quote/oracle whitelist can replace this at MarketConfig.

fields.name: poolCount
docs: Number of pools registered via init_pool.

fields.name: usdcMint
docs: Canonical USDC mint (S0). Pinned once at initialize_registry from a
typed Mint account with decimals == USDC_DECIMALS; immutable — there

accounts.name: UserAccount
docs: UserAccount PDA — seeds [b"user", pool, owner].
Maps to TS `UA`. One account holds balances + shared margin + one long/short
leveraged-spot position + one long/short perp position (option legs later).
Phase 1 keeps fixed fields ("shared margin shell + per-product risk isolation"),
NOT full portfolio margin — that is an explicit product decision pending in
docs (decision list, chapter 4 of the PRD).
SPL-denominated balances and margin are u64 token amounts. Position
economics (entry prices, settled accumulators, notional) are u128 — see
audit decision D2 (docs/core-math-porting-guide.md).

fields.name: balance0
docs: SPL token amount (u64).

fields.name: balance1
docs: SPL token amount (u64).

fields.name: margin
docs: SPL token amount (u64), quote (USDC) side.
Semantics (audit #6): this is the *SPL-denominated, withdrawable* margin
amount. Internal equity/PnL/funding/settled-accumulator math must NOT be
compressed into this u64 — those live in u128 fields and only downcast
at real SPL transfer/withdrawal points.

fields.name: lspLong
docs: Leveraged-spot long (borrow quote -> buy base); zeroed when flat.

fields.name: lspShort
docs: Leveraged-spot short (borrow base -> sell); zeroed when flat.

fields.name: perp
docs: Perp position (Phase 2B, spec §3.1); zeroed when flat.

fields.name: referrer
docs: Referrer's pubkey. Pubkey::default() = unbound.
Immutable after first bind (enforced in bind_referrer handler).

fields.name: referralAccruedUsdc
docs: Accumulated USDC commission claimable by this user as referrer.
Only incremented when this user is the *referrer* of a trader.

fields.name: referralDiscountAccruedUsdc
docs: Total USDC discount applied to this user as referee (informational;
not claimable — reduces user_fee at trade time).

accounts.name: VolRegimeState
docs: VolRegimeState PDA — tracks the vol-based width regime state machine.
One per pool (when vol_width_enabled = true).

fields.name: pool
docs: Backref to parent pool (seeds constraint).

fields.name: volRegime
docs: Current active regime (0=calm, 1=normal, 2=elevated, 3=extreme).

fields.name: volRegimeSince
docs: When the current regime was set (unix seconds).

fields.name: pendingVolRegime
docs: Pending regime candidate (255 = none, 0-3 = candidate regime).

fields.name: pendingSince
docs: When the pending candidate started (0 = none).

fields.name: lastWidenTime
docs: Last normal widen execution time (cooldown reference).

fields.name: lastNarrowTime
docs: Last normal narrow execution time (cooldown reference).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: CollateralPolicyParams
docs: Full parameter set for init/update (full-replacement semantics — the
update mirrors configure_session: every governance field is rewritten
from the args, so a partial client call can never leave a stale field
silently in force).

CollateralPolicy: every governance field is rewritten from the args,
identity fields pool/global_locked/bump/version stay untouchable).

types.name: MaturityInitParams
docs: Full parameter set for initialize_market_maturity (spec §E all governance

types.name: RampTier
docs: Ramp tier entry (duration + cap).

types.name: PerpPosition
docs: Per-UA perp position (§3.1). Lives inside UserAccount; all-zero = flat.

fields.name: size
docs: Position size (token-denominated).

fields.name: entryPrice
docs: Entry price after clampEntryPrice (E32).

fields.name: settledFundingAcc
docs: Snapshot of the side's PAID funding accumulator at open/last settle.

fields.name: settledBorrowAcc
docs: Reserved for future perp borrow linkage (§10.6 undecided).

fields.name: reserveBasisUsdc
docs: S1-00B: IF risk capital reserved for this position (canonical USDC E6,
unsigned). Set at open = notional × PERP_STRESS_BPS / BPS; released
in full at close/liquidation (S1-04 owns partial release).

types.name: PerpRiskWindowState
docs: 10-minute perp risk window: window start + per-side opened notional.

types.name: LspPosition
docs: Leveraged-spot position (TS `LSPLong`/`LSPShort`).
All-zero means no position.

fields.name: sizeToken
docs: Long: boughtToken. Short: soldToken (token borrowed and sold).

fields.name: entryPrice
docs: Entry price (E32-scaled).

fields.name: borrowed
docs: Long: borrowedQuote (USDC). Short: borrowedToken.

fields.name: settledInterestAcc
docs: accInterestPerBorrowed snapshot at open (Aave-style; interest =
borrowed * (accNow - settled) / E18).

fields.name: collateral

excludes shared margin (known defect causing early liquidation);
v1 proposal is collateral + margin share risk (designed_fix).
